{{Quote|Karness Muur, whose Force-centered battle tactics had saved us from the trap at Fluwhaka.|Sorzus Syn|<ref name="BoS" />}}
The '''trap at Fluwhaka''' was a battle fought between the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] against the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] during the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]]. It took place at the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Fluwhaka]], and was a ambush set up by the Jedi and Republic intending to trap the Dark Jedi; however, the [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-centered military tactics of [[Karness Muur]] prevented it from succeeding.<ref name="BoS" />
